question: Does the local H95-2514Figure 27.14 hook contradict or reconcile with Meadow/Kenoyer 1997 Figure 10.17?
method: Extract Meadow/Kenoyer 1997 Figure 10 accession IDs and match them against local Lipi excavation-idno values by accession, not by figure number. One OCR-ambiguous public row, 10.14, was added from rendered-page inspection as H95-2417.
result: The accession bridge reconciles H-2147 at object level: Meadow/Kenoyer 1997 Figure 10.17 is H95-2514, and local metadata records H-2147 as H95-2514Figure 27.14. The figure-number difference is therefore not an object-identity contradiction; it is a publication/figure-system difference.
ocr_note: pdftotext misreads several Trench 11 entries as Trench II. Rendered page inspection shows Trench 11 for H95-2514 / 10.17.
